title: Marcos at BRICS: India’s iSON Group sets expansion in PH

blocks.text: NEW DELHI, India — An Indian conglomerate is infusing $75 million (P4.7 billion) for its current operations and future expansion in the Philippines, which are expected to generate about 2,000 jobs, Malacañang said on Sunday.
